newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank opens T$ option trading.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank opens T$ option trading.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank announced on Wednesday it would allow option trading in the Taiwan dollar, effective immediately.
Deputy central bank governor Liang Cheng-chin made the announcement after the Taiwan foreign exchange market closed on Wednesday.
The move will offer options trading for Taiwan companies and investors in exchanges between the Taiwan dollar and other foreign currencies.
Taiwan already allows foreign exchange options trading between foreign currencies.
Taiwan, which started financial derivatives trading in early 1994, so far allows more than 10 derivatives to be traded, including cross-currency swaps, margin, option and interest rate swap trading.
